questions.question: What needs to be done to avoid the worst impacts of climate change?

questions.solution:

questions.question: Why are chemosynthetic bacteria not dependent on the conversion of light energy for survival?

questions.question: Identify the tone of the passage.
questions.questionHtml: Identify the tone of the passage.
questions.solution:
The passage provides us factual information about photosynthesis. It tells us what photosynthesis is and why it is important for the maintenance of life on Earth. Further, it tells us about organisms that can survive without photosynthesis. Lastly, it provides information about how photosynthesis led to the creation of fossil fuels, millions of years ago. Thus, A is the right answer.

questions.question: Which process helped deposit the remains of green plants in Earth's crust?

questions.solution:
